title: Council Order 0015495: existing building ordered out of Group C occupancy pending structural and environmental engineer letters before change of occupancy
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order (acting through an accredited agency)
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2014 (stated in the order)
document_date: 2019-09-20 (Council Order 0015495); the underlying order is dated 2019-05-01

facts.text: The Tribunal varied an order dated 2019-05-01, issued under section 49 of the Safety Codes Act by an accredited agency for an accredited municipality against the property owner under the Alberta Building Code 2014.

The original direction was to cease occupying the building as a Group C occupancy and, within 60 days, to provide structural and environmental (mould) letters of conformance before any renovation to a Group D, E or F-3 occupancy.

The varied order requires a structural engineer's report on integrity, a determination of feasible occupancy group(s) within 120 days, and permit applications; option 1 pairs essential structural remediation under engineer direction with establishing a change of use to the selected occupancy.
The order requires the proper fire ratings of exterior walls to adjacent property lines to be ensured before the building is renovated for another occupancy.
The findings of fact record fire-chief observations on the need for a fire alarm and smoke detectors, and that there is no secondary egress through a window in certain areas.
